text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Zephyr! Yamanin Zephyeeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That was a great race! You ran 
wonderfully! I'm really looking forward to 
your next performance too!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
!? H-Huh?! Wait, just now............ 
Huh?!?!?!

With the New Zealand Trophy and the Aoi 
Stakes, Yamanin Zephyr had left behind 
brilliant results.

As an up-and-coming Umamusume, the public 
is finally starting to recognize her true 
ability. ...One could say the time is 
ripe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then, just as planned. As we've discussed 
before—
choice_data_list: Yeah. Next up is the G1 race!
Yeah. Next up is finally the G1 race!

text_block_list.text:
If we're setting a goal starting now, the 
Sprinters Stakes in September, right after 
summer, seems ideal.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then our next goal shall be 
the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, I watched it. The day after 
the Aoi Stakes, at the Japanese Derby—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
When Teio-san became the dawn breeze, 
heralding the arrival of the next legend— 
the birth of an undefeated Double Crown 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, I felt my soul boil, and 
a storm began to rage within.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I, too—cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes. I shall conquer it 
without fail."

Her encounter with Tokai Teio served as 
great motivation, and Yamanin Zephyr is 
now full of determination.

Her potential is more than sufficient. 
With the summer training camp ahead, she 
should be able to prepare thoroughly and 
face the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be caught in a dry breeze. 
...Is there something on your mind?

Naturally, it wasn't something to hide. 
Nodding slowly in return, she continues.
choice_data_list: If we're aiming for the Sprinters Stakes—

text_block_list.text:
She must now face the formidable champions 
currently stirring up the Sprint and Mile 
circuits... including the Senior Class 
girls.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The Senior Class Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ……Please tell me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Just what kind of storm awaited ahead.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What I must accomplish upon the turf is 
already decided. I shall simply become the 
wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Being able to focus solely on that is an 
absolute blessing. ...Fufu.

Back around her debut race, Yamanin Zephyr 
barely seemed to pay any attention to her 
surroundings, but—

Through interacting with Tokai Teio, her 
perspective broadened immensely.

And now, she sought to burn the image of 
those two great walls into her very eyes—
